arc.energy_shape_notes: One groove, one valley, one restart. Quiet intro (mean -27.2dB) -> Eb-minor plateau (-21 to -23dB) -> 15s valley at 3:50 (-30.0dB) where the root slips Eb->D -> rebuild in D minor -> loudest close: final 30s mean -17.9dB, ends at peak (-17.6dB) with a hard stop at 7:32.4, no fade, no coda. Dynamic range 12.9dB. The valley is the hinge; the ending is the opposite of ARTIFICIAL INSTRUMENTS' dark coda - this one stops at its loudest.

No raised leading tone, no V-i cadences, no secondary dominants - never resolve; ends on the second tonic at maximum level.
